class.name: MeshDirectAccess
class.brief_description: Internal type used to access mesh data in memory.
class.description: This is an internal type used by The Conservatory which allows C# code to access the low-level memory representation of geometry data. This is typically used to upload or patch geometry [i]extremely[/i] quickly compared to the typical API, as it becomes possible to skip most of the intermediary steps.

method.name: mesh_add_surface_ptr
method.description: Add a surface to the provided [param mesh] by providing a pointer to a [code]SurfaceData[/code] that can be read from.

method.name: mesh_get_surface_ptr
method.description: Read the surface at index [param idx] from the provided [param mesh] by providing a pointer to a [code]SurfaceData[/code] that can be written to.
